note: Written before any W4 candidate, direction demonstration or portal page existed, and pinned by registry.lock.json written in the same state. What that priority is worth is stated in pre_registration_evidence rather than asserted. A field that cannot be checked is marked so explicitly.

pre_registration_evidence.claim: rubric.v4.md and this registry were written before any W4 artefact existed.
pre_registration_evidence.what_the_files_can_show: Both files are pinned by digest in rubric.v4.lock.json and registry.lock.json. Both locks were written while cases/, directions/, portal/, baselines/ and renders/ did not exist. tools/verify.mjs asserts both digests and asserts that both files' modification times precede every authored artefact and every render in this working tree.
pre_registration_evidence.what_the_files_cannot_show: The mtime ordering does not survive a fresh Git checkout, so a later reader cannot re-observe it; the digests do survive and pin the bytes, not the moment. Neither proves the author's intent preceded the drawing — only that these bytes did.
pre_registration_evidence.how_this_differs_from_w3: W3's registry.json carried no lock at all, and its inode postdated seven of eleven candidate pages. Two of one candidate's composition declarations were rewritten, in one edit, after its renders had been inspected, and the study then claimed only marker tokens had changed. Both claims were withdrawn by an independent audit. This registry is locked before authoring precisely so that failure cannot be repeated quietly; if a declaration here is changed later, amendments records it and A8 fails when it is empty while a change is known.
pre_registration_evidence.standing: The digests are durable and checkable. The ordering is witnessed in this checkout only. Read amendments before weighing A2, A3, A4 or A9.

thresholds.note: Declared once, by this study, because the project records none. rubric.v4.md names no size, palette or viewport; every gate that needs a number reads it from here.
thresholds.legibility_scope: every text node inside a figure element, measured from computed style on the rendered page
thresholds.accessibility_target: WCAG 2.2 AA; automated axe over the WCAG 2.0/2.1/2.2 A and AA tags is partial evidence, never proof of conformance

altitudes.decides: which content model should carry drawn explanation in cf-present at all, and what each one makes impossible
altitudes.why_first: Ten of W3's eleven candidates were qualified negative against the product's real contract. Selecting a composition winner under a carrier the product will not build chooses which drawing to fail to ship.

altitudes.decides: given a carrier, which encoding explains this subject best

board_reassessment.note: Responsibility 2 of the recovery brief: the board itself is reassessed, not only the bands that failed. Each case is checked for whether it asks a real user question, whether siblings differ in unit/axis/relationship rather than styling, whether the visible composition makes the relationship discoverable without printing the answer, whether the three contexts preserve the governing idea by deliberate recomposition, and whether the plain baselines remain honest controls.

cases.why: The operator's real decision when approving a plan is which task to protect. The question asks for consequence, not lookup, and a candidate showing only order or only dependency incidence cannot separate a task with room from one without.
cases.sibling_verdict: kept — unit task/axis wave position against unit path/axis path length is a difference in what is measured, not in styling
changes: a-critical-path-and-room's narrow composition is replaced, not repaired: see dispositions.json

cases.why: Acceptance of an evidence set turns on the causes of its gaps. An encoding that renders absence as a blank cell answers coverage and not cause.
cases.sibling_verdict: kept — unit claim+rail/axis derivation stage against unit missing piece/axis cause
changes: a-stopped-provenance's narrow composition is replaced: the W3 narrow band drew each stop as a rule spanning the figure's full width, which reads as a section divider rather than a stop on a rail, and left each cause caption abutting the next claim's title
a-stopped-provenance declares five cell states, not four: the W3 page drew notclaimed and keyed four

cases.why: Attribution decides whether the harness or its environment is the thing to fix, and an encoding with no ordered round axis cannot separate a re-opening from an ordinary later edit.
cases.sibling_verdict: kept — unit finding/axis round against unit source region/axis file position

The W3 page put real diff text in a fixed column with hidden overflow at every width, so the render did not carry the line its own source contract verifies. The quoted lines now wrap with a hanging indent instead of being cropped, and the round rail's tick labels sit inside the viewBox.

cases.why: Orientation is exactly the pairing of location with the discipline that governs it. W2's lookup question was already withdrawn for being decided by its own shape.
cases.sibling_verdict: kept — volatility stratification, spine descent, and write-authority partition are three different primary axes
changes: c-write-authority-map: the W3 registration said the one split-authority path is drawn straddling the perimeter and the page drew it wholly inside the editable region with a miniature internal divider. Neither was moved in W3 because the judging seat may not redraw. Here the straddle is declared and will be drawn.
the plain baseline is re-authored so it does not overflow a 390px viewport

cases.why: Trust in a record is exactly authority plus evidence, and the two parts want opposite geometry. Registered as a decomposition, not a competition.
A control the reader cannot see whole makes the comparison unfair in the baseline's favour as well as the candidate's.
changes: re-authored to fit a 390px viewport by wrapping, not by becoming a design: no new colour, no new geometry, no figure

contexts.note: The intermediate width is not a convention: every candidate declares the two widths at which its own composition changes, and the intermediate render must land strictly between them, so the intermediate frame always shows a composition neither of the other two frames shows.
contexts.rule: for every candidate, narrow_breakpoint < tablet.width < wide_breakpoint, and the page must declare a max-width media query at each of its two breakpoints

motion.why: W3 declared none-authored globally. W4 keeps that for every case candidate, and declares it separately per direction: a content model that owns motion is a materially different model from one that cannot express it, and that difference is part of what the contract altitude decides.
motion.evidence: checks/motion.json — per render, document.getAnimations() and a computed-style sweep for a running animation or a non-zero transition duration, captured under both prefers-reduced-motion settings

drawn_geometry_paths.how: Mermaid source compiled in the parent document and inlined as hardened SVG
drawn_geometry_paths.gets: document tokens, resolved mode, useMaxWidth sizing, role=img with title and desc
drawn_geometry_paths.loses: a mark cannot be placed at a computed position, a bar cannot be sized to a quantity, empty space cannot be reserved, and a region cannot be hatched

drawn_geometry_paths.how: served from /sandbox/<revision>/<opaque-id> into a bare-sandbox iframe under default-src 'none'; script-src 'none'
drawn_geometry_paths.gets: arbitrary inert markup and inline SVG
drawn_geometry_paths.loses: inline CSS may not contain '@', so no media query, no prefers-color-scheme, no prefers-reduced-motion and no @font-face; no script, so the block cannot size its own frame; the review stylesheet constrains only its inline size

drawn_geometry_paths.how: a bounded base64 PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/MP4/WebM/MP3/Ogg inlined as a data URI
drawn_geometry_paths.gets: anything that can be rasterised, up to 4 MiB decoded
drawn_geometry_paths.loses: mode, responsive recomposition, text scaling, selection, machine-readable structure, and any accessible equivalent beyond alt and caption

docs_portal.generator: Astro/Starlight over a repository-owned content graph
docs_portal.raw_html_in_source: escaped outside code fences, with no configuration bypass
docs_portal.consequence: a portal composition can only be emitted by the generator; there the constraint ends, because the portal's composition lives in a real stylesheet with media queries, colour-scheme handling and reduced motion all available

directions.title: Curated semantic primitives
directions.one_line: The product ships a closed set of named typed blocks, each modelling one kind of subject relationship. The document supplies typed data and no geometry.
directions.document_supplies: typed data conforming to a named primitive's schema
directions.runtime_owns: geometry, scales, tokens, mode, responsive recomposition, legend, accessible description, non-colour channels
directions.mechanism: directions/a-primitives/primitives.js — one exported renderer per primitive, taking a JSON record and returning SVG
directions.negative_artefact: d2 record authority — reach as extent against a record's own claims, which no shipped primitive models
directions.reach: exactly the relationships the shipped primitives model, rendered consistently and accessibly every time, with no way for a document to draw a wrong or ugly figure
directions.cannot_express: any relationship no primitive models; two relationships composed in one frame; a subject whose shape is genuinely one of a kind
directions.extension_path: new product code — a new block type, a schema version, a renderer, tests, and a release

directions.title: Bounded declarative scene grammar
directions.one_line: One new typed block carries a scene: named scales over declared domains, a closed set of marks positioned by those scales, registers, per-band recomposition and non-colour state channels. The runtime compiles it; the document composes it.
directions.document_supplies: a scene: scales, marks, registers, bands, states, legend and description
directions.runtime_owns: the compiler, tokens, mode, the mark vocabulary, containment, and refusal of anything outside the grammar
directions.mechanism: directions/b-scene/scene.js — a compiler from a scene document to SVG, with no imperative hook the document can reach
directions.negative_artefact: a force-directed dependency layout, which the grammar has no operator to compute
directions.reach: any composition expressible as marks placed by declared scales — including every one of W3's eleven candidates that the closed catalogue refused
directions.cannot_express: anything needing a layout algorithm the grammar does not implement (force layout, treemap, text flow around marks, automatic label de-collision); anything needing per-datum imperative logic
directions.extension_path: a new subject form is a new scene in a document, with no product change. A new mark kind or scale type is product code.
directions.motion: none authored; the grammar reserves no motion operator in this demonstration

directions.title: Project-neutral recipe library
directions.one_line: The runtime executes primitives; a versioned library of named, parameterised recipes ships as a managed skill asset. The document names a recipe and binds real data to its slots.
directions.composition_authority: a reviewed library, versioned with the skill rather than the binary
directions.document_supplies: a recipe name and a binding of its declared slots to real data
directions.runtime_owns: the executor, the primitive renderers, tokens, mode, and refusal of an unknown recipe or an unbound slot
directions.mechanism: directions/c-recipes/recipes.js — a recipe registry plus a binder that compiles a named recipe and its bindings into primitive calls
directions.negative_artefact: the same d2 record authority, to show what a library that has no recipe for a subject actually does
directions.reach: whatever the library covers, uniformly, with a name a later reader can look up and a review gate on each addition
directions.cannot_express: a genuinely novel relationship, until a recipe for it is written and reviewed
directions.extension_path: contribute a recipe — a managed asset, reviewed and versioned with the skill, with no binary release

directions.title: Authored SVG under a runtime service contract
directions.one_line: The document carries inline SVG the agent drew, and the runtime supplies what the sandboxed escape cannot: token substitution, mode, a declared responsive variant set, viewBox sizing and an enforced legend and description.
directions.document_supplies: up to three SVG variants with declared breakpoints, a token vocabulary reference, a legend and a description
directions.runtime_owns: sanitisation, token substitution, mode resolution, variant selection, and the legend/description requirement
directions.mechanism: directions/d-authored-svg/service.js — the token, mode and variant service applied to author-supplied SVG at load
directions.negative_artefact: the same subject drawn twice by the same contract with no shared authority, to show what does not accumulate
directions.reach: maximal — anything an agent can draw
directions.cannot_express: nothing, and that is the finding: the model has no way to know whether what was drawn is right, no reuse between documents, no accumulated quality, and every explanation pays full authoring cost again
directions.extension_path: there is nothing to extend and nothing accumulates
directions.motion: none authored; the contract could carry it and the demonstration does not
directions.security_delta: moving author-supplied SVG out of the opaque-origin sandbox iframe and into the parent document is the material change and is judged as such, not assumed safe

directions.title: Pre-rendered raster through the existing media block
directions.one_line: No contract change at all. The agent renders its own figure out of band and embeds a bounded PNG.
directions.composition_authority: the authoring agent, out of band
directions.document_supplies: a base64 PNG and its alt text
directions.runtime_owns: byte bounds and the data URI
directions.mechanism: directions/e-raster/raster.js — the demonstration embeds a PNG produced from another direction's output at authoring time, exactly as an agent would have to
directions.negative_artefact: the same PNG in dark mode and at 390px, which is the whole finding
directions.cannot_express: mode, responsive recomposition, text scaling, selection, machine-readable structure, or any accessible equivalent beyond alt

cases.subject: the unfinished EPC-005 task graph
cases.surface_job: An operator is shown a plan inside a review document and must decide where the schedule risk is before approving or redirecting it. The job is judgement about consequence, not lookup of a field.
cases.question: If exactly one unfinished EPC-005 task slipped by one wave, which tasks would move the finish and which would not?

forbidden_patterns.why: the chain written out as a run of arrows states the relationship the geometry exists to show
attaching a room quantity to a named task in prose answers the question in a sentence
names the length of the chain the reader is asked to find

cases.subject: the TSK-007 qualification evidence at exact candidate 82671551
cases.surface_job: A reviewer is shown an evidence set and must judge what it does not cover before accepting it. The job is to see the shape of what is missing, and why each piece is missing, without the absences being smoothed away.
cases.question: Which platforms carry executed evidence for the exact candidate, and for each platform that does not, what kind of thing stopped it?

compound.why_not_decomposed: coverage is only interpretable through the causes, so both candidates carry both and each declares which part its axis optimises

forbidden_patterns.why: a counted summary of how many claims stop short is the answer, not a label
states the coverage finding in prose

candidates.primary_axis: wave position — the earliest wave the task can occupy
candidates.encoded_relationship: consequence of delay: one unbroken line threads the tasks it passes through, and every task carries a cap on the same wave scale — set out along a ticked track where a later start exists, flush on the task's own wave line where none does, so having none is drawn rather than left out
candidates.wide_composition: the wave axis runs left to right; each task sits at its earliest wave; the unbroken run is one solid line threading the tasks it passes through; a later start is drawn as a ticked track extending rightward from the task's own row, ending in a cap on the wave line that limits it
candidates.intermediate_composition: the single field splits into two registers against the same horizontal wave axis, separated by a drawn divider: the unbroken run above it, everything that can start later below it with its track
candidates.narrow_composition: REPLACED, and declared here before drawing. The axis rotates: waves become rows down the page and the run descends through them. Extent does NOT rotate with the axis and does NOT share a gutter. Each task's later start is measured horizontally inside that task's own row, against one shared wave scale drawn once at the head of the figure, ending in a cap at the wave that limits it. A task with no room carries a cap flush against its own card, in its own row. Two tasks can no longer occupy one column, because no two rows are the same row.
candidates.why_replaced: The W3 narrow band measured every task's later start downward in one shared gutter at a single x. TSK-013's and TSK-009's tracks merged into one continuous column, three caps landed on the same wave boundary and rendered as one mark, and one zero-room cap was orphaned below the last row attached to nothing. The reader could not recover which task had how much room, which is the question. Everything was inside the frame, so no containment probe saw it.

states.means: can start later without moving the finish
the wave that limits a later start

carrier.loss: The encoding is position on an axis plus a drawn link plus a length-proportional extent. `table` and `status` keep every fact and lose all three. `diagram` can draw the link but cannot place a task at a computed wave position or size an extent to a quantity. The sandboxed escape block can draw it, but with no media query it cannot switch to either declared alternate composition and cannot follow the document's mode.

candidates.primary_unit: a claim and the rail its evidence travels along
candidates.primary_axis: derivation stage, from what produced the evidence to what accepted it
candidates.encoded_relationship: distance travelled and where it stopped: a filled run up to the stopping node, then a reserved open remainder that is drawn rather than omitted, with each rail head carrying the platform coverage that claim actually has
candidates.wide_composition: rails run left to right through four stage columns; the filled run ends at a stop mark; the untravelled remainder stays drawn as an open rail to the last stage; the coverage strip sits beside each rail head
candidates.intermediate_composition: rails keep their horizontal stage axis and the coverage strip moves above the rail head rather than beside it
candidates.narrow_composition: REPLACED, and declared here before drawing. Each claim becomes a bounded lane with its own left edge. The rail runs down inside that lane, inset from both edges so it can never span the figure's width. The stop is a short cross-tick on the rail, not a rule; its cause caption sits inside the same lane, indented to the rail, above the lane's own lower edge. The untravelled remainder stays drawn below the stop to the lane's foot. The coverage strip is the lane's head row.
candidates.why_replaced: The W3 narrow band drew each stop as a long horizontal rule running from the figure's left edge across roughly 40% of empty width to the rail, which reads as a section divider rather than as a stop on a rail; and each cause caption was left-aligned at the far edge, directly abutting the next claim's title with no separation, so the cause attached visually to the wrong claim. Attribution is exactly what P2's question asks for.

states.means: the stages it did not reach, drawn rather than omitted
an executed run on that lane
the claim does not reach this lane

candidates.states_note: Five cell states are declared, and five will be keyed. W3 declared four, drew five, keyed four, and named four in its accessible description; the cross on the Chromium claim's second lane appeared in none of them. A12 now compares all four sets.

carrier.loss: `status` has exactly the right state vocabulary — pass, fail, pending, not_run — and no geometry at all, so the distance a claim travelled before stopping disappears entirely. A table renders the untravelled remainder as an empty cell, which is the one thing this encoding exists to avoid.

amendments_note: Empty at registration. Any post-registration change to a registered field is appended here with its field, candidate, timing, reason, and which of drawing or declaration moved first — never applied by editing the field silently. A8 fails when this array is empty while a change is known.
invalidated_bands_note: Populated by tools/render.mjs and the author's own inspection. Every entry carries both an admissibility verdict and the demonstrated failure that made it so — kind, severity, failing axes. Inadmissible is not neutral.

convergence_hypotheses.note: Recorded as hypothesis only. One study, one author and mutually exclusive artefacts earn no system layer, and nothing here is promoted into a shared visual primitive.
observed: reserved-absence — several artefacts draw a deliberate absence as occupied space rather than an empty cell. Untested against subject independence, real coexistence, or an accepted product surface with a reuse need.
